researchQuestion: Can privacy-minimized structured mutation features materially increase supported T1-T9 failure-cause classification coverage without retaining raw model output or weakening local-first privacy?
hypothesis: Level-1 deterministic derived edit features increase supported semantic classification coverage and reduce T14 relative to Level-0 hash-only views, without raw-output persistence or secret leakage.

design.pairing: Each transient edit deterministically yields both L0 and L1 analyst views; analysts are blinded to the alternate view.

level1Schema.selectedFile: normalized repo-relative path after secret scan
level1Schema.identifiersReferencedOrModified: salted hashes plus role/count; never raw names
level1Schema.literalChanges: literal type, length and salted hash; never raw literal
level1Schema.apiCallChanges: salted callee hashes and add/remove counts
level1Schema.verificationFailure: frozen stage/status/code and bounded diagnostic hash

extraction.method: Parse before/after source with pinned Tree-sitter; compute feature deltas before deleting replacement bytes.

L2MayBeProposedOnlyIf: L1 supported T1-T9 coverage remains below 0.30
L1 raw/derived privacy checks all pass
written necessity analysis shows which causes cannot be distinguished

precedence.rule: Required evidence exists in the repository and frozen retrieval metadata proves it was not selected or included.
The first authoritative failure is P2 action validation or patch construction, before semantic execution can be evaluated.
Syntax/type formation is the first failure and no stronger semantic cause is supported by persisted edit evidence.
Required information is proven absent from model-visible context and was not a retrievable-but-missed repository item covered by T11.
A necessary cross-file dependency is central, evidence was sufficient, and observable edit evidence proves it was missed.
Required companion work is within one file or otherwise not centrally cross-file, evidence was sufficient, and observable edit evidence proves incomplete scope.
Observable edit behavior addresses a different requested behavior; task text alone is not enough.
Visible model-available verification evidence was sufficient and observable edit behavior contradicts that contract.
Observable edit behavior specifically mishandles exception type, propagation, fallback, retry, message, or error state.
Observable edit behavior contradicts an available API, caller, return-type, or public-interface contract.
Observable edit behavior mishandles mutation, copy, lifecycle, dependency ordering, stale state, or propagated values.
Core observable edit is otherwise supported but fails a specific boundary, sentinel, empty, null, first/last, or off-by-one case.
Evidence and scope are local and sufficient and observable edit behavior implements incorrect branch, operator, ordering, calculation, or return semantics.
Use whenever persisted evidence cannot distinguish a stronger cause; never infer a semantic cause from failure stage or oracle alone.

analysisPlan.l0AndL1Classification: Apply the same frozen T1-T14 rules independently to paired views
analysisPlan.audits: Two independent passes; disagreements preserved and adjudicated fail-closed to T14/LOW

interpretation.passMeaning: L1 is a viable privacy-preserving diagnostic evidence tier.
interpretation.failMeaning: L1 did not establish adequate observability; it does not authorize L2 or prove model semantics adequate.
interpretation.futureTreatmentExperiment: Separate and selected only after the dominant supported cause is observed.
